trial_title: CMR Based Prediction of Ventricular Tachycardia Events in Healed Myocardial Infarction (DEVELOP-VT)
brief_summary: Fibrotic tissue is known to be the substrate for the appearance of scar-related reentrant ventricular arrhythmias (VA) in chronic ischemic cardiomyopathy (ICM). Late gadolinium enhancement cardiac magnetic resonance (LGE-CMR) has proven to be a useful technique in the non-invasive characterization of the scarred tissue and the underlying arrhythmogenic substrate. Previous studies identified the presence of significant scarring (\> 5% of the left ventricular -LV- mass) is an independent predictor

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has systemic mastocytosis and tachycardia, but there is no information provided about ischemic heart disease.
